items.source: Spring Boot uses some relaxed rules for binding Environment properties to @ConfigurationProperties beans, so there does not need to be an exact match between the Environment property name and the bean property name. Common examples where this is useful include dash-separated environment properties (for example, context-path binds to contextPath), and capitalized environment properties (for example, PORT binds to port).
items.translation: Spring Boot 用于将 Environment 属性绑定到 @ConfigurationProperties Bean 时采用了一些宽松规则，因此 Environment 属性名与 Bean 属性名之间无需完全匹配。 常见的有用示例包括使用连字符分隔的环境属性（例如，context-path 绑定到 contextPath），以及大写的环境属性（例如，PORT 绑定到 port）。

items.source: You can also add a custom Spring Validator by creating a bean definition called configurationPropertiesValidator. The @Bean method should be declared static. The configuration properties validator is created very early in the application’s lifecycle, and declaring the @Bean method as static lets the bean be created without having to instantiate the @Configuration class. Doing so avoids any problems that may be caused by early instantiation.
items.translation: 您还可以通过创建一个名为 configurationPropertiesValidator 的 bean 定义来添加自定义 Spring Validator。 @Bean 方法应声明为 static。 配置属性验证器在应用程序的生命周期中创建得非常早，将 @Bean 方法声明为 static 使得无需实例化 @Configuration 类即可创建该 bean。 这样做可以避免因过早实例化而可能引发的问题。

items.source: When the @ConfigurationProperties bean is registered using configuration property scanning or through @EnableConfigurationProperties, the bean has a conventional name: <prefix>-<fqn>, where <prefix> is the environment key prefix specified in the @ConfigurationProperties annotation and <fqn> is the fully qualified name of the bean. If the annotation does not provide any prefix, only the fully qualified name of the bean is used.
items.translation: 当使用配置属性扫描或通过@EnableConfigurationProperties注册带有@ConfigurationProperties的 Bean 时，该 Bean 具有约定名称：<prefix>-<fqn>，其中<prefix>是@ConfigurationProperties注解中指定的环境键前缀，而<fqn>是 Bean 的全限定名。如果注解未提供任何前缀，则仅使用 Bean 的全限定名。

items.source: We recommend that @ConfigurationProperties only deal with the environment and, in particular, does not inject other beans from the context. For corner cases, setter injection can be used or any of the *Aware interfaces provided by the framework (such as EnvironmentAware if you need access to the Environment). If you still want to inject other beans using the constructor, the configuration properties bean must be annotated with @Component and use JavaBean-based property binding.
items.translation: 我们建议 @ConfigurationProperties 仅处理环境配置，特别是不要从上下文中注入其他 Bean。 对于特殊情况，可以使用 setter 注入，或使用框架提供的任何 *Aware 接口（例如，如果您需要访问 EnvironmentAware 以获取对 Environment 的访问权限）。 如果您仍希望通过构造函数注入其他 Bean，则必须将配置属性 Bean 标注为 @Component 并使用基于 JavaBean 的属性绑定。

items.source: Spring Boot attempts to coerce the external application properties to the right type when it binds to the @ConfigurationProperties beans. If you need custom type conversion, you can provide a ConversionService bean (with a bean named conversionService) or custom property editors (through a CustomEditorConfigurer bean) or custom converters (with bean definitions annotated as @ConfigurationPropertiesBinding).
items.translation: Spring Boot 在将外部应用程序属性绑定到 @ConfigurationProperties Bean 时，会尝试将其强制转换为正确的类型。 如果您需要自定义类型转换，可以提供 ConversionService Bean（bean 名称为 conversionService），或自定义属性编辑器（通过 CustomEditorConfigurer Bean），或自定义转换器（使用带有 @ConfigurationPropertiesBinding 注解的 bean 定义）。

items.source: By default, SpringApplication converts any command line option arguments (that is, arguments starting with --, such as --server.port=9000) to a property and adds them to the Spring Environment. items.source: The values in application.properties and application.yaml are filtered through the existing Environment when they are used, so you can refer back to previously defined values (for example, from System properties or environment variables). The standard ${name} property-placeholder syntax can be used anywhere within a value. Property placeholders can also specify a default value using a : to separate the default value from the property name, for example ${name:default}.
items.translation: `application.properties` 和 `application.yaml` 中的值在使用时会被现有的 Environment 过滤，因此您可以引用之前定义的值（例如来自系统属性或环境变量）。 标准的 ${name} 占位符语法可以在值中的任何位置使用。 占位符还可以使用 : 指定默认值，将默认值与属性名分隔开，例如 ${name:default}。

items.source: Spring Boot does not provide any built-in support for encrypting property values, however, it does provide the hook points necessary to modify values contained in the Spring Environment. items.translation: Spring Boot 不提供任何用于加密属性值的内置支持，但它提供了修改 Spring Environment 中所含值所需的钩子点。 EnvironmentPostProcessor 接口允许您在应用程序启动之前操作 Environment。 有关详细信息，请参阅在启动前自定义 Environment 或 ApplicationContext。

items.source: Profile-specific properties are loaded from the same locations as standard application.properties, with profile-specific files always overriding the non-specific ones. items.source: The use of Optional with @ConfigurationProperties is not recommended as it is primarily intended for use as a return type. As such, it is not well-suited to configuration property injection. For consistency with properties of other types, if you do declare an Optional property and it has no value, null rather than an empty Optional will be bound.
items.translation: 不建议将 Optional 与 @ConfigurationProperties 一起使用，因为它主要设计用作返回类型。 因此，它并不适合用于配置属性注入。 为了与其他类型的属性保持一致，如果您声明了一个 Optional 属性且该属性没有值，将绑定 null 而不是一个空的 Optional。

items.source: Properties that use the [index] notation can be bound to Java List or Set objects using Spring Boot’s Binder class. For more details see the Type-safe Configuration Properties section below.
items.translation: 使用 [index] 表示法的属性可以通过 Spring Boot 的 Binder 类绑定到 Java List 或 Set 对象。 有关详细信息，请参见下面的类型安全配置属性部分。

items.source: To use constructor binding the class must be enabled using @EnableConfigurationProperties or configuration property scanning. You cannot use constructor binding with beans that are created by the regular Spring mechanisms (for example @Component beans, beans created by using @Bean methods or beans loaded by using @Import)
items.translation: 若要使用构造函数绑定，必须通过 @EnableConfigurationProperties 或配置属性扫描来启用该类。 您无法使用构造函数绑定由常规 Spring 机制创建的 Bean（例如 @Component Bean、通过 @Bean 方法创建的 Bean，或通过 @Import 加载的 Bean）。

items.source: You may want to rename your custom ConversionService if it is not required for configuration keys coercion and only rely on custom converters qualified with @ConfigurationPropertiesBinding. When qualifying a @Bean method with @ConfigurationPropertiesBinding, the method should be static to avoid “bean is not eligible for getting processed by all BeanPostProcessors” warnings.
items.translation: 如果不需要对配置键进行强制转换，您可能希望重命名自定义的ConversionService，并仅依赖带有@ConfigurationPropertiesBinding注解的自定义转换器。 当使用@ConfigurationPropertiesBinding注解限定@Bean方法时，该方法应为static，以避免“bean 无法被所有 BeanPostProcessors 处理”的警告。

items.source: Although null values from the JSON will be added to the resulting property source, the PropertySourcesPropertyResolver treats null properties as missing values. This means that the JSON cannot override properties from lower order property sources with a null value.
items.translation: 尽管来自 JSON 的 null 值会被添加到结果属性源中，但 PropertySourcesPropertyResolver 将 null 属性视为缺失值。 这意味着 JSON 无法使用 null 值覆盖来自较低优先级属性源的属性。

items.source: Filenames with dot notation are also correctly mapped. For example, in the above example, a file named myapp.username in /etc/config would result in a myapp.username property in the Environment.
items.translation: 使用点表示法的文件名也能正确映射。例如，在上述示例中，位于 /etc/config 下名为 myapp.username 的文件将导致在 Environment 中生成一个 myapp.username 属性。

items.source: The spring-boot-actuator module includes an endpoint that exposes all @ConfigurationProperties beans. Point your web browser to /actuator/configprops or use the equivalent JMX endpoint. See the Production ready features section for details.
items.translation: spring-boot-actuator 模块包含一个端点，用于暴露所有 @ConfigurationProperties Bean。 将 Web 浏览器指向 /actuator/configprops，或使用等效的 JMX 端点。 有关详细信息，请参阅 生产就绪功能 部分。

items.source: Both directory and file location values are also expanded to check for profile-specific files. For example, if you have a spring.config.location of classpath:myconfig.properties, you will also find appropriate classpath:myconfig-<profile>.properties files are loaded.
items.translation: 目录和文件位置的值也会展开，以检查特定于配置文件的文件。例如，如果您的spring.config.location为classpath:myconfig.properties，您还将发现会加载适当的classpath:myconfig-<profile>.properties文件。

items.source: The names of the folders and files under the config tree form the property name. In the above example, to access the properties as username and password, you can set spring.config.import to optional:configtree:/etc/config/myapp.
items.translation: config 树下的文件夹和文件名构成了属性名称。 在上述示例中，若要访问名为 username 和 password 的属性，您可以将 spring.config.import 设置为 optional:configtree:/etc/config/myapp。

items.source: Multi-document property files cannot be loaded by using the @PropertySource or @TestPropertySource annotations.
items.translation: 无法使用 @PropertySource 或 @TestPropertySource 注解加载多文档属性文件。

items.source: YAML files cannot be loaded by using the @PropertySource or @TestPropertySource annotations. So, in the case that you need to load values that way, you need to use a properties file.
items.translation: 无法使用 @PropertySource 或 @TestPropertySource 注解加载 YAML 文件。 因此，如果您需要以这种方式加载值，则必须使用属性文件。

items.source: The prefix value for the annotation must be in kebab case (lowercase and separated by -, such as my.main-project.person).
items.translation: 注解的 prefix 值必须使用连字符小写格式（即由小写字母组成，并用 - 分隔，例如 my.main-project.person）。

items.source: If you are upgrading a Long property, make sure to define the unit (using @DurationUnit) if it is not milliseconds. Doing so gives a transparent upgrade path while supporting a much richer format.
items.translation: 如果您正在升级一个 Long 属性，请确保如果单位不是毫秒，则定义该单位（使用 @DurationUnit）。 这样做可以提供透明的升级路径，同时支持更丰富的格式。

items.source: If you are upgrading a Long property, make sure to define the unit (using @DataSizeUnit) if it is not bytes. Doing so gives a transparent upgrade path while supporting a much richer format.
items.translation: 如果您正在升级一个 Long 属性，请确保如果单位不是字节，则定义该单位（使用 @DataSizeUnit）。 这样做可以在支持更丰富格式的同时提供透明的升级路径。

items.source: You can also trigger validation by annotating the @Bean method that creates the configuration properties with @Validated.
items.translation: 您也可以通过使用 @Validated 注解创建配置属性的 @Bean 方法来触发验证。

items.source: If you use environment variables rather than system properties, most operating systems disallow period-separated key names, but you can use underscores instead (for example, SPRING_CONFIG_NAME instead of spring.config.name). See Binding From Environment Variables for details.
items.translation: 如果您使用环境变量而不是系统属性，大多数操作系统不允许使用点分隔的键名，但您可以改用下划线（例如，使用 SPRING_CONFIG_NAME 而不是 spring.config.name）。 有关详细信息，请参阅从环境变量绑定。

items.source: The env and configprops endpoints can be useful in determining why a property has a particular value. You can use these two endpoints to diagnose unexpected property values. See the Production ready features section for details.
items.translation: `env` 和 `configprops` 端点可用于确定属性为何具有特定值。您可以使用这两个端点来诊断意外的属性值。有关详细信息，请参阅生产就绪功能部分。

items.source: spring.config.name, spring.config.location, and spring.config.additional-location are used very early to determine which files have to be loaded. They must be defined as an environment property (typically an OS environment variable, a system property, or a command-line argument).
items.translation: spring.config.name、spring.config.location 和 spring.config.additional-location 在非常早期被用于确定需要加载哪些文件。 它们必须作为环境属性定义（通常是操作系统环境变量、系统属性或命令行参数）。

items.source: A wildcard location must contain only one * and end with */ for search locations that are directories or */<filename> for search locations that are files. Locations with wildcards are sorted alphabetically based on the absolute path of the file names.
items.translation: 通配符位置必须仅包含一个 * 并以 */ 结尾，用于搜索目录位置，或为 */<filename> 用于搜索文件位置。 带有通配符的位置将根据文件的绝对路径按字母顺序排序。

items.source: When appropriate, Profile-specific variants are also considered for import. The example above would import both my.properties as well as any my-<profile>.properties variants.
items.translation: 在适当的情况下，还会考虑导入特定于 Profile 的变体。 上面的示例将同时导入my.properties以及任何my-<profile>.properties变体。

items.source: Configuration tree values can be bound to both string String and byte[] types depending on the contents expected.
items.translation: 配置树值可以根据预期内容绑定为字符串 String 和 byte[] 类型。

items.source: See also the differences between @Value and type-safe configuration properties.
items.translation: 另请参阅与 @Value 的类型安全配置属性之间的差异。

items.source: To use a reserved keyword in the name of a property, such as my.service.import, use the @Name annotation on the property’s field.
items.translation: 若要在属性名称中使用保留关键字（例如 my.service.import），请在该属性的字段上使用 @Name 注解。

items.source: To use a reserved keyword in the name of a property, such as my.service.import, use the @Name annotation on the constructor parameter.
items.translation: 若要在属性名称中使用保留关键字（例如 my.service.import），请在构造函数参数上使用 @Name 注解。

items.source: Using @ConfigurationProperties also lets you generate metadata files that can be used by IDEs to offer auto-completion for your own keys. See the appendix for details.
items.translation: 使用 @ConfigurationProperties 还可以生成元数据文件，供 IDE 为您的自定义键提供自动补全功能。 有关详细信息，请参阅附录。

items.source: It is recommended to stick with one format for your entire application. If you have configuration files with both .properties and YAML format in the same location, .properties takes precedence.
items.translation: 建议在整个应用程序中统一使用一种格式。 如果同一位置同时存在 .properties 和 YAML 格式的配置文件，则 .properties 优先。

items.source: Use the prefix optional: if the locations are optional and you do not mind if they do not exist.
items.translation: 如果位置是可选的，并且您不介意它们不存在，请使用前缀optional:。

items.source: This feature also supports specifying the extension. The default extension is .properties.
items.translation: 此功能还支持指定扩展名。默认扩展名为.properties。

items.source: Multi-document property files are often used in conjunction with activation properties such as spring.config.activate.on-profile. See the next section for details.
items.translation: 多文档属性文件通常与激活属性（如 spring.config.activate.on-profile）配合使用。有关详细信息，请参阅下一节。

items.source: The prefix only applies to system environment properties. The example above would continue to use remote.timeout when reading properties from other sources.
items.translation: 前缀 仅 适用于系统环境属性。 上面的示例在从其他来源读取属性时，将继续使用 remote.timeout。

items.source: The properties that map to @ConfigurationProperties classes available in Spring Boot, which are configured through properties files, YAML files, environment variables, and other mechanisms, are public API but the accessors (getters/setters) of the class itself are not meant to be used directly.
items.translation: 映射到 Spring Boot 中可用的 @ConfigurationProperties 类的属性，这些类通过属性文件、YAML 文件、环境变量和其他机制进行配置，属于公共 API，但该类本身的访问器（getter/setter）不打算直接使用。

items.source: To use constructor binding the class must be compiled with -parameters. This will happen automatically if you use Spring Boot’s Gradle plugin or if you use Maven and spring-boot-starter-parent.
items.translation: 若要使用构造函数绑定，必须使用 -parameters 编译该类。如果您使用 Spring Boot 的 Gradle 插件，或者使用 Maven 和 spring-boot-starter-parent，此操作将自动完成。

items.source: The Period type never actually stores the number of weeks, it is a shortcut that means “7 days”.
items.translation: Period 类型实际上从不存储周数，它只是一个快捷方式，表示“7 天”。

items.source: If your application runs in a servlet container or application server, then JNDI properties (in java:comp/env) or servlet context initialization parameters can be used instead of, or as well as, environment variables or system properties.
items.translation: 如果您的应用程序在 Servlet 容器或应用服务器中运行，则可以使用 JNDI 属性（位于 java:comp/env）或 Servlet 上下文初始化参数来替代环境变量或系统属性，或者与它们一起使用。

items.source: Wildcard locations only work with external directories. You cannot use a wildcard in a classpath: location.
items.translation: 通配符位置仅适用于外部目录。 您不能在 classpath: 位置中使用通配符。

items.source: Properties files are only ever loaded once. If you have already directly imported a profile specific property files then it will not be imported a second time.
items.translation: 属性文件仅加载一次。 如果您已经直接导入了特定于配置文件的属性文件，则不会再次导入。

items.source: optional: prefixes are not considered when determining if a location is fixed or import relative.
items.translation: optional: 前缀在确定位置是固定的还是导入相对时不会被考虑。

items.source: You can also use this technique to create “short” variants of existing Spring Boot properties. See the Use ‘Short’ Command Line Arguments section in “How-to Guides” for details.
items.translation: 您也可以使用此技术来创建现有 Spring Boot 属性的“短”变体。有关详细信息，请参阅“操作指南”中的使用“短”命令行参数部分。

items.source: If you use starters, SnakeYAML is automatically provided by spring-boot-starter.
items.translation: 如果您使用启动器，SnakeYAML 将由 spring-boot-starter 自动提供。

items.source: We recommend that, when possible, properties are stored in lower-case kebab format, such as my.person.first-name=Rod.
items.translation: 我们建议，在可能的情况下，属性应存储为小写连字符格式，例如 my.person.first-name=Rod。

items.source: The Resource property can also be used to provide the path to the resource, making it more versatile.
items.translation: Resource 属性也可用于提供资源路径，使其更加灵活。

items.source: Directories loaded using a wildcard are sorted alphabetically. If you need a different order, then you should list each location as a separate import
items.translation: 使用通配符加载的目录按字母顺序排序。 如果您需要不同的顺序，则应将每个位置列为单独的导入项。

items.source: Property file separators must not have any leading whitespace and must have exactly three hyphen characters. The lines immediately before and after the separator must not be same comment prefix.
items.translation: 属性文件分隔符不能有任何前导空格，且必须恰好包含三个连字符。 分隔符前后的行不能使用相同的注释前缀。

items.source: For YAML files, the brackets need to be surrounded by quotes for the keys to be parsed properly.
items.translation: 对于 YAML 文件，键周围的括号需要用引号括起来才能正确解析。

items.source: The preceding merging rules apply to properties from all property sources, and not just files.
items.translation: 前述合并规则适用于所有属性源中的属性，而不仅仅是文件。
